consequence.statement: The max_transfer_retries setting, used to transfer chunks to new ingesters during rolling restarts, is removed; the Write Ahead Log (WAL) replaces it, so verify the WAL covers your rolling-restart use.

original.statement: The ingester setting max_transfer_retries (-ingester.max-transfer-retries) is removed in favor of the Write Ahead Log (WAL).

decision.reason: [ev-c6e07f70e7d9] says `max_transfer_retries` (`-ingester.max-transfer-retries`) is removed "in favor of the Write Ahead log (WAL)" and describes its rolling-restart chunk-transfer role, so the function is replaced by a named mechanism. That matches superseded-upstream: verify the replacement covers your use. The excerpt never says that a configuration still setting it fails or is rejected, so a mandatory kind such as P2's setting-ignored would over-claim. Confidence is low because the "Alternatives to this setting are:" list is cut off in the excerpt.
